verse.verse_12: Let him who will, pay heed to it.
verse.verse_13: It is set down on honoured pages,
verse.verse_17: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!
verse.verse_18: Of what [stuff] has He created him?
verse.verse_19: Out of a drop of sperm! He creates and proportions him,
verse.verse_20: He makes his path easy for him.
verse.verse_21: Then He causes him to die and be buried.
verse.verse_22: Then when He pleases, He will bring him back to life.
verse.verse_23: Yet man declines to do His bidding.
verse.verse_24: Let man reflect on the food he eats.
verse.verse_25: We let the rain pour down in torrents
verse.verse_26: and then We cleaved the earth asunder.
verse.verse_27: We make the grain grow out of it,
verse.verse_29: and olive trees and date palms
verse.verse_32: as provision for you and for your cattle to enjoy.
verse.verse_33: But when the deafening blast is sounded,
verse.verse_34: on that Day a man shall flee from his own brother,
verse.verse_37: on that Day every man among them will have enough concern of his own --
verse.verse_38: on that Day some faces will be beaming,
verse.verse_40: but some faces will be covered with dust
verse.verse_42: those will be ones who denied the truth and were immersed in iniquity.
